verdict.rationale: Veriff ships web and native SDKs and a SaaS platform, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack documents such an opt-out. The statement that test-integration sessions do not count towards paid usage is about billing, not tracking, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
